content.short: Pigeon Hodl is a story-based, CNFT art collection about the modern way of pigeon keeping.
content.description:
PIGEON HODL is a story-based, low-supply animated NFT collection created by artist Martynas Auz, and it’s happening on Cardano. You can adopt a pigeon to admire, share, sell, or collect, and you don’t need to build a coop or clean up any mess – just hodl them in the blockchain. In that way, we’re bringing the tradition of pigeon keeping into the innovative tech era. COLLECTION The collection is going to be authentic and rare, completely handmade without autogeneration or some other silly shit.

Each pigeon will be a work of art. That’s why PIGEON HODL is not dropping all 999 of them at once. Instead, the pigeons will be released over 9 seasons: 111 pigeons a month until the whole flock is out. With each release, we‘ll drop an animated short—each one a piece of the puzzle to the whole pigeon story.
